item.tib: byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par bshad pa
item.skt: bo d+hi tsit+ta bi bA ra NaM
item.coloph: byang chub sems kyi rnam par bshad pa slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /chos 'di mdzad pa po che ba dang / brjod bya bzang pa dang / rjod byed dbyings su gyur pa'i stobs kyis rtsal phyung zhing bsgyur ba mang du snang ba las lo tsA ba rab zhi chos kyi bshes gnyen gyi la gzhi byas te/ gu ru chos kyi shes rab dang / seng dkar shAkya 'od dang /shes rab grags dang /mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug dang /pa tshab nyi ma grags dang / mang nad grags 'byor shes rab kyis 'gyur bdun las/ don gang bzang ba rnams bris pa yin no
